title: Microsoft Teams: send chat messages while a file uploads in the background
summary: The briefing accurately reports the default-on change, unchanged file storage and policies, and the differing roadmap and Message Center schedules. No actionable claim requires correction; the Targeted Release start should be described as Microsoft's scheduled start rather than a confirmed historical event.

claims.quote: Files (including OneNote and Wiki) that someone shares in a channel are stored in the team's SharePoint site.

claims.where: controls[0].ui and controls[0].api; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft documents no tenant or policy switch specifically controlling background-upload message-box behaviour on either the admin UI or automation surface.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams background uploads policy; Teams background file upload disable Set-CsTeamsMessagingPolicy Microsoft Graph policy admin role. Opened settings reference, messaging/files cmdlets and Native File Upload policy. NativeFileEntryPoints controls storage entry points, not asynchronous behaviour.

claims.where: Governance controls

claims.quote: Searched: upload and file throughout the fetched Set-CsTeamsMessagingPolicy reference; Teams background file upload disable Set-CsTeamsMessagingPolicy Microsoft Graph policy admin role. Only AutoShareFilesInExternalChats concerns files; it controls automatic external sharing, not upload behaviour.
